meta.title: My garage
meta.description: Your company’s equipment fleet: maintenance log, repairs, parts, costs, photos and due dates.

error.title: The garage could not open

engine.canvas: 3D garage of the equipment fleet. The machines can also be reached from the list at the bottom of the screen and in workshop mode.

welcome.demoLead: The garage for your equipment fleet.
welcome.demoCopy: Six machines from a construction firm in Valais, with twelve months of logbook: services, repairs, parts, costs, photos and due dates. Try everything: nothing is saved.
welcome.copy: Every machine has its full log: services, repairs, replaced parts, costs, photos, videos and upcoming due dates.
welcome.copyEmpty: Add your first machine: its log, due dates and costs will fill up as work is recorded.
welcome.sound: Sound starts with this button. You can mute it at the top right.

overview.law: Swiss OPA, Art. 32b: maintenance of work equipment must be documented. Every entry is dated and stays in this log: a withdrawn entry is struck through, never erased.

machineForm.codeHint: Marked on the machine and on the floor of its bay.
machineForm.hoursLower: Lower reading: only use this to correct an input error.
machineForm.defaultsHint: Godet adds two default due dates: a service every 500 h and the annual safety inspection. You can adjust them.
machineForm.errCode: Give the machine an internal code, for example EX-02.
machineForm.errCodeLong: The code is 16 characters at most.
machineForm.errCodeTaken: The code {code} is already used in the fleet. Choose another one.
machineForm.errWeight: Enter the weight in tonnes, for example 21 or {example}.
machineForm.errHours: Enter the hour meter reading in figures (0 for a new machine).

hoursForm.title: Hour meter
hoursForm.last: Last reading: {hours}, on {date}. The hour meter can only go forward.
hoursForm.label: Current reading (h)
hoursForm.hintEmpty: Enter the hours shown on the machine’s hour meter.

hoursForm.hintBig: +{hours} since the last reading: that is a lot, check the value.

scheduleForm.label: Name
scheduleForm.everyHint: Leave empty for a one-off due date.
scheduleForm.errLabel: Give the due date a name, for example “Service”.
scheduleForm.errEveryHours: Enter an interval in hours, for example 500.
scheduleForm.errDueHours: Enter the hour meter reading at which the next due date falls.
scheduleForm.errEvery: Enter an interval, for example 1 year.
scheduleForm.errDueDate: Enter the date of the next due date.

removeForm.title: Withdraw the entry
removeForm.text: The maintenance log keeps a record of everything (Art. 32b OPA): the entry stays visible, struck through, with the reason below, the date and your name. Its costs are no longer counted.
removeForm.reasonPlaceholder: Why is this entry being withdrawn?
removeForm.errReason: Say why this entry is being withdrawn: the reason stays visible in the log.
removeForm.errReasonLong: The reason is 300 characters at most.
removeForm.done: Entry withdrawn: it stays in the log, struck through, with its reason

archiveForm.title: Archive {code}?
archiveForm.text: The machine leaves the garage and the fleet list. Its log, costs, photos and documents are kept.
archiveForm.meterYear: Hour meter when archived: {hours} · in service since {year}.

deleteScheduleForm.title: Delete “{label}”?
deleteScheduleForm.text: Godet will no longer remind you of this due date for {code}. Entries already recorded stay in the log.
